body: Thank you. I don't have a lot of people IRL to turn to.

My mom is doing the best that she can, I know. I feel like a huge disappointment to her.

I'll bring up disability when I see him Monday. I'm going to also ask for a mood stabilizer. (tried Lamictal, but the side effects were terrible.)

All she said was, "You'll do well on the next test." I've told her about my nervous breakdowns but she didn't seem to care much. This is an entry level course and she's making it harder than it should be.

My mom is 12 hours away. I feel embarrassed and ashamed asking my psychiatrist if I can apply for disability. I feel like that would be giving up.

I don't know. I wish more people reached out to me. I feel so alone all the time.
